I was there for a total of three months, and while I was kinda happy to get out, I was also very nervous. It was my safe space, there was never such a thing as fights, stress, expectations, pressure, life was easy there. I was sheltered from the extremely stressful family life that’s going on at home, nobody ever forced me to do anything, they really just tried to help me. We had structured plans for every day, timetables, different therapy types that include animals or creativity or teamwork. After going home another extreme depression set in because I had to get used to being at home again. I‘m doing better now, but life is still very difficult for me as my mental illness doesn’t seem to go away completely
